# Format settings

Every setting of [`custos format`](./formatting), grouped by what it
lays out. Set them in the `format.settings` object of
[`custos.json`](./configuration#format), or for one run with
`--set id=value`; `custos format --show-config` prints the value each
one takes and where it comes from. A `keep` value leaves that part of
the layout as written.

Presets (the [Formatting guide](./formatting#presets) explains how to pick
one; `per` is the default):

- [`psr1`](https://www.php-fig.org/psr/psr-1/)
- [`psr12`](https://www.php-fig.org/psr/psr-12/)
- [`per`](https://www.php-fig.org/per/coding-style/)
- [`symfony`](https://symfony.com/doc/current/contributing/code/standards.html)
- [`laravel`](https://laravel.com/docs/pint)
- [`drupal`](https://project.pages.drupalcode.org/coding_standards/php/coding/)

Risky settings change more than the layout and stay off unless allowed; in
the preset tables, a cell such as `false`, risky: `true` gives the value a
preset applies only when risky settings are allowed (`--allow-risky` or `allowRisky`).

## File

| Setting | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `indent_style` | enum | `space`, `tab`, `keep` | Indent with spaces or tabs; `keep` leaves indentation as written. |
| `indent_size` | int | integer, 0 or more | Columns per indentation level when indenting with spaces. |
| `tab_width` | int | integer, 0 or more | Columns a tab counts for when measuring line length. |
| `continuation_indent` | enum | `one`, `keep` | Indentation of a line continuing a statement or list item: one level more than its first line (deeper levels written for nested operands are kept), or `keep` the offset written, alignment included. |
| `line_ending` | enum | `lf`, `crlf`, `cr`, `keep` | Line break written between lines outside strings; `keep` uses the file's first line break. |
| `final_newline` | bool | `true`, `false` | End a file of PHP code with exactly one line break. |
| `trim_trailing_whitespace` | bool | `true`, `false` | Remove spaces and tabs at the end of lines outside strings and inline HTML. |
| `remove_bom` | bool | `true`, `false` | Remove a UTF-8 byte order mark. |
| `closing_tag` | enum | `remove`, `keep` | Remove the `?>` that ends a file containing only PHP code. |
| `open_tag_own_line` | bool | `true`, `false` | Put the `<?php` that starts a PHP-only file on its own line. |
| `blank_line_after_open_tag` | bool | `true`, `false` | Leave one blank line between the opening `<?php` line and the code. |
| `max_blank_lines` | int | integer, 0 or more | Most consecutive blank lines kept anywhere; 0 keeps any number. |
| `line_length` | int | integer, 0 or more | Target width of a line in columns; wrapping and the line length report use it. 0 disables both. |
| `wrap` | enum | `long`, `off` | `long` puts one item per line in lists that exceed `line_length` or are partly split; `off` keeps line breaks as written. |
| `report_long_lines` | bool | `true`, `false` | Report the lines that stay wider than `line_length` after formatting; a check then fails on them. |
| `join_fitting_lists` | bool | `true`, `false` | Join a multi-line list back on one line when it fits and holds no comment. |

Preset values:

| Setting | `psr1` | `psr12` | `per` | `symfony` | `laravel` | `drupal` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `indent_style` | `keep` | `space` | `space` | `space` | `space` | `space` |
| `indent_size` | `4` | `4` | `4` | `4` | `4` | `2` |
| `tab_width` | `4` | `4` | `4` | `4` | `4` | `4` |
| `continuation_indent` | `keep` | `one` | `one` | `one` | `one` | `one` |
| `line_ending` | `keep` | `lf` | `lf` | `lf` | `lf` | `lf` |
| `final_newline` | `false` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` |
| `trim_trailing_whitespace` | `false` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` |
| `remove_bom` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` |
| `closing_tag` | `keep` | `remove` | `remove` | `remove` | `remove` | `remove` |
| `open_tag_own_line` | `false` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` |
| `blank_line_after_open_tag` | `false` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` |
| `max_blank_lines` | `0` | `1` | `1` | `1` | `1` | `1` |
| `line_length` | `0` | `120` | `120` | `120` | `120` | `80` |
| `wrap` | `off` | `long` | `long` | `long` | `off` | `long` |
| `report_long_lines` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false` |
| `join_fitting_lists` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false` |

## Braces

| Setting | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `class_brace` | enum | `next_line`, `same_line`, `keep` | Opening brace of a class, interface, trait or enum. |
| `function_brace` | enum | `next_line`, `same_line`, `keep` | Opening brace of a function or method; after a signature split over several lines it always follows `)` on the same line. |
| `closure_brace` | enum | `next_line`, `same_line`, `keep` | Opening brace of a closure. |
| `anonymous_class_brace` | enum | `next_line`, `same_line`, `keep` | Opening brace of an anonymous class. |
| `control_brace` | enum | `next_line`, `same_line`, `keep` | Opening brace of a control structure. |
| `else_position` | enum | `same_line`, `next_line`, `keep` | Whether `else` and `elseif` follow the closing brace on its line or start the next one. |
| `catch_position` | enum | `same_line`, `next_line`, `keep` | Whether `catch` and `finally` follow the closing brace on its line or start the next one. |
| `single_line_closures` | bool | `true`, `false` | Keep a closure or anonymous class written on one line on one line. |
| `empty_body` | enum | `inline`, `keep` | Write the empty body of a class or function as `{}` on its declaration line. |

Preset values:

| Setting | `psr1` | `psr12` | `per` | `symfony` | `laravel` | `drupal` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `class_brace` | `keep` | `next_line` | `next_line` | `next_line` | `next_line` | `same_line` |
| `function_brace` | `keep` | `next_line` | `next_line` | `next_line` | `next_line` | `same_line` |
| `closure_brace` | `keep` | `same_line` | `same_line` | `same_line` | `same_line` | `same_line` |
| `anonymous_class_brace` | `keep` | `same_line` | `same_line` | `same_line` | `next_line` | `same_line` |
| `control_brace` | `keep` | `same_line` | `same_line` | `same_line` | `same_line` | `same_line` |
| `else_position` | `keep` | `same_line` | `same_line` | `same_line` | `same_line` | `next_line` |
| `catch_position` | `keep` | `same_line` | `same_line` | `same_line` | `same_line` | `next_line` |
| `single_line_closures` | `true` | `false` | `false` | `true` | `false` | `false` |
| `empty_body` | `keep` | `keep` | `inline` | `keep` | `inline` | `keep` |

## Lines

| Setting | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `statement_per_line` | bool | `true`, `false` | Start each statement on its own line. |
| `single_line_throw` | bool | `true`, `false` | Write a `throw` statement on one line, whatever its length, unless it holds a comment, a closure or a heredoc. |
| `blank_line_after_namespace` | bool | `true`, `false` | One blank line after a `namespace` declaration. |
| `blank_line_after_imports` | bool | `true`, `false` | One blank line after the last `use` import. |
| `blank_line_between_import_groups` | bool | `true`, `false` | One blank line between class, function and constant imports. |
| `class_open_blank_line` | enum | `one`, `none`, `keep` | Blank line after the opening brace of a class. |
| `class_close_blank_line` | enum | `one`, `none`, `keep` | Blank line before the closing brace of a class. |
| `trim_block_blank_lines` | bool | `true`, `false` | Remove blank lines after the opening and before the closing brace of a function or control structure. |
| `blank_line_after_trait_use` | bool | `true`, `false` | One blank line between the trait imports of a class and its next member. |
| `method_separation` | enum | `one`, `keep` | One blank line between a method and the member before it. |
| `property_separation` | enum | `one`, `none`, `keep` | Blank line between consecutive properties. |
| `constant_separation` | enum | `one`, `none`, `keep` | Blank line between consecutive class constants. |
| `case_separation` | bool | `true`, `false` | One blank line before a `case` or `default` that follows the statements of the previous one. |
| `blank_line_before` | list | list of `break`, `continue`, `declare`, `do`, `for`, `foreach`, `if`, `return`, `switch`, `throw`, `try`, `while`, `yield` | Statements preceded by a blank line unless they open their block. |

Preset values:

| Setting | `psr1` | `psr12` | `per` | `symfony` | `laravel` | `drupal` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `statement_per_line` | `false` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` |
| `single_line_throw` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `true` | `false` | `false` |
| `blank_line_after_namespace` | `false` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` |
| `blank_line_after_imports` | `false` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` |
| `blank_line_between_import_groups` | `false` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` |
| `class_open_blank_line` | `keep` | `none` | `none` | `none` | `none` | `one` |
| `class_close_blank_line` | `keep` | `none` | `none` | `none` | `none` | `one` |
| `trim_block_blank_lines` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `true` | `true` | `false` |
| `blank_line_after_trait_use` | `false` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` |
| `method_separation` | `keep` | `keep` | `keep` | `one` | `one` | `one` |
| `property_separation` | `keep` | `keep` | `keep` | `keep` | `one` | `keep` |
| `constant_separation` | `keep` | `keep` | `keep` | `keep` | `one` | `keep` |
| `case_separation` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `true` |
| `blank_line_before` | `[]` | `[]` | `[]` | `return` | `continue`, `return` | `[]` |

## Spacing

| Setting | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spacing` | bool | `true`, `false` | Normalize the spaces between tokens on a line (keywords, operators, commas, brackets). |
| `concat_space` | enum | `one`, `none`, `keep` | Spaces around the `.` operator. |
| `binary_operator_space` | enum | `one`, `at_least_one` | Spaces around binary and assignment operators; `at_least_one` keeps alignment. |
| `cast_space` | enum | `one`, `none`, `keep` | Space after a cast such as `(int)`. |
| `not_operator_space` | enum | `none`, `one` | Space after the `!` operator. |
| `arrow_function_space` | enum | `none`, `one`, `keep` | Space between `fn` and `(`. |
| `anonymous_class_space` | enum | `one`, `none`, `keep` | Space between `class` and `(` in `new class(...)`. |
| `closure_space` | enum | `one`, `none` | Space between `function` and `(` of a closure. |

| `binary_operator_space` | `at_least_one` | `at_least_one` | `at_least_one` | `one` | `one` | `one` |
| `cast_space` | `keep` | `keep` | `one` | `one` | `one` | `one` |
| `not_operator_space` | `none` | `none` | `none` | `none` | `one` | `none` |
| `arrow_function_space` | `keep` | `keep` | `none` | `one` | `one` | `keep` |
| `anonymous_class_space` | `keep` | `one` | `one` | `one` | `none` | `one` |

## Syntax

| Setting | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trailing_comma` | list | list of `arguments`, `arrays`, `closure_use`, `destructuring`, `match`, `parameters` | Lists that end with a comma when split over several lines; arguments and closure `use` need PHP 7.3, parameters PHP 8.0. |
| `single_line_trailing_comma` | bool | `true`, `false` | Keep a trailing comma in a list written on one line. |
| `array_syntax` | enum | `short`, `long`, `keep` | `[]` or `array()` for array literals. |
| `list_syntax` | enum | `short`, `long`, `keep` | `[]` or `list()` for destructuring (short needs PHP 7.1). |
| `visibility` | enum | `all`, `methods_properties`, `keep` | Write the implicit `public` of class members that declare no visibility: methods, properties and constants (PHP 7.1), or methods and properties. |
| `parameter_attribute_line` | bool | `true`, `false` | Put the attributes of a parameter on a line of their own when the parameters are one per line. |
| `elseif` | bool | `true`, `false` | Write `else if` as `elseif`. |
| `new_parentheses` | enum | `add`, `remove`, `keep` | Parentheses after a class name in `new` without arguments. |
| `standardize_not_equals` | bool | `true`, `false` | Write `<>` as `!=`. |
| `hash_comment` | bool | `true`, `false` | Write `#` comments as `//`. |
| `operator_linebreak` | enum | `start`, `start_booleans`, `keep` | Move an operator that ends a line to the start of the next: every binary operator, or only `&&`, `\|\|`, `and`, `or`, `xor`. |

Preset values:

| Setting | `psr1` | `psr12` | `per` | `symfony` | `laravel` | `drupal` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `trailing_comma` | `[]` | `[]` | `arguments`, `arrays`, `closure_use`, `destructuring`, `match`, `parameters` | `arrays`, `destructuring`, `match`, `parameters` | `arrays` | `arrays`, `destructuring`, `parameters` |
| `single_line_trailing_comma` | `true` | `true` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false` |
| `array_syntax` | `keep` | `keep` | `short` | `short` | `short` | `short` |
| `list_syntax` | `keep` | `keep` | `keep` | `short` | `short` | `keep` |
| `visibility` | `keep` | `all` | `all` | `all` | `methods_properties` | `all` |
| `parameter_attribute_line` | `false` | `false` | `true` | `true` | `false` | `true` |
| `elseif` | `false` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` |
| `new_parentheses` | `keep` | `add` | `add` | `add` | `remove` | `add` |
| `standardize_not_equals` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `true` | `true` | `true` |
| `hash_comment` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `true` | `true` | `false` |
| `operator_linebreak` | `keep` | `keep` | `start` | `start_booleans` | `keep` | `keep` |

## Imports

| Setting | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `import_order` | enum | `alpha`, `length`, `none` | Sort `use` imports within each group, alphabetically (case-insensitive) or by length. |
| `import_groups` | enum | `class_function_const`, `const_class_function`, `none` | Order of the class, function and constant import groups. |
| `no_leading_import_slash` | bool | `true`, `false` | Remove the leading `\` of an imported name. |
| `single_trait_per_statement` | bool | `true`, `false` | Split `use A, B;` in a class into one statement per trait (not when it adapts methods). |
| `single_import_per_statement` | bool | `true`, `false` | Split `use A, B;` into one statement per import. |

## Risky

| Setting | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `yoda` (risky) | enum | `yoda`, `regular`, `keep` | Order of the operands of `==`, `!=`, `===` and `!==` when one is a literal or constant: first (`yoda`) or last (`regular`). |
| `single_quote` (risky) | bool | `true`, `false` | Write double-quoted strings without escapes or interpolation in single quotes. |
| `remove_unused_imports` (risky) | bool | `true`, `false` | Remove `use` imports the file never mentions, docblocks included. |
| `declare_strict_types` (risky) | bool | `true`, `false` | Add `declare(strict_types=1);` to PHP-only files that lack it (PHP 7.0+). |
| `increment_style` (risky) | enum | `pre`, `post`, `keep` | Write a standalone increment or decrement statement as `++$i` or `$i++`. |
| `heredoc_to_nowdoc` (risky) | bool | `true`, `false` | Write a heredoc without escapes or interpolation as a nowdoc. |

Preset values:

| Setting | `psr1` | `psr12` | `per` | `symfony` | `laravel` | `drupal` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `single_quote` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false`, risky: `true` | `false`, risky: `true` | `false` |
| `remove_unused_imports` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false`, risky: `true` | `false`, risky: `true` | `false` |
| `declare_strict_types` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false` |
| `increment_style` | `keep` | `keep` | `keep` | `keep`, risky: `pre` | `keep`, risky: `post` | `keep` |
| `heredoc_to_nowdoc` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `false`, risky: `true` | `false` |
